user_prompt: Build me a voice-controlled turret that tracks blue balls

decomposed_tasks.goal: A tabletop pan-and-tilt turret that tracks blue objects and responds to simple voice commands.

geometry_spec.description: Wide cylindrical base with a two-axis servo bracket, camera mast, and front sensor cradle.
geometry_spec.stability_requirement: Must remain stable through 45 degrees of lateral tilt.

firmware_spec.control_logic: Listen for track, hold, and sweep commands while keeping the turret centered on the tracked target and clamping servo travel to safe angles.

parts_list.name: Arduino Uno Rev3
parts_list.description: Main controller for the turret logic and sensor I/O.

parts_list.name: MG996R High Torque Servo
parts_list.description: Provides enough torque for the pan stage and payload.

parts_list.name: HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Sensor
parts_list.description: Used for distance-based target centering and collision avoidance.

parts_list.name: Voice Recognition Module V3
parts_list.description: Provides simple local voice command recognition for turret control.

sim_failure_reason: Stable at 0, 15, 30, and 45 degree lateral tilt.
